name: Oozora Manatsu
source:
One of the six friends who had been lost in the deep sea five years ago. [spoiler]Returning to the island in her ghost form, she reunited with all of her childhood friend near the beach, where they were once spending their good time there.[/spoiler] 

[Edited and some parts roughly translated from [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/natsuuta/]official website[/url].]
